# RIP - shared; parliament_names.
# Country labels identify the content family, not additional eligibility gates.
# Whole definitions are grouped here; keep each text-branch order and random setting.
# Generated by tools/build_parliament_names.py - edit the RULES table there.
# The title of the parliament window. The first rule whose trigger holds names the parliament; the
# last rule is vanilla's own title. Read only by the scripted text box rip_parliament_title.
# `random = no` is what makes it the FIRST. Without it EU4 does not take the first row that holds: measured 2026-10-19 with three rows
# that all held, 30 evaluations on one date gave the second row every time, and a Rada government was titled "Rada of the Land",
# the tag row below its reform's own. With `random = no` 30 of 30 gave the first row.
